_about: The sound libraries, one per plan. tools/build-libraries.py turns each into <id>-<version>.zip with a manifest.json (sounds: tools/sounds-vcsl.py, IRs: tools/make-irs.py, pad loops: tools/make-pads.py, Central Utility's clicks and lighting looks: tools/make-utility.py); .github/workflows/libraries.yml builds and publishes them. Raise a library's version when its content changes.

libraries.title: Central Keys Library
libraries.summary: Two grand pianos (Steinway B and Kawai), an upright, FM pianos, a clavisynth and a harpsichord; pipe, quiet and positive organs; vibraphone, marimba, xylophone, glockenspiel, bells and hand chimes; eighteen stereo pads, each with its own character (warm, air, choir aah and ooh, shimmer, strings, glass, swell, worship, analog sweep, dark, bell, a Sunday-keys worship pad, Ember and Selah Strings - a grand piano and a string section stretched into clouds - and Sunday Bright, Easter Brass and Christmas Bells) - with worship-ready presets; and ten synths made by us, each its own kind (saw, square and soft leads, synth brass, super saw, string machine, sub and synth bass, a plucked string, FM electric bells). 10.5: real electric pianos - a Wurlitzer EP200, a CP80 electric grand and a Pianet T (Greg Sullivan's recordings, CC-BY 3.0) - with six presets for them And the Pop Grand - AKAI's Splendid Grand (public domain), the bright, even piano of a thousand records - with three presets.

libraries.title: Central Instrument Library
libraries.summary: Four drum kits (studio, rock, unruly, brushes); hollowbody, archtop and clean electric guitars; upright (plucked and bowed), jazz and hollowbody basses; alto and baritone saxes and a sax section; harps, kalimbas, recorders, harmonicas, saxello, ocarina, world instruments and percussion kits - with presets to play from keys or your instrument; an electric upright bass (plucked and bowed); and twenty drum and percussion loops for the texture channels, each with its own feel and tempos - worship eighths, a big ride, rim and hat, half-time, four on the floor, driving sixteenths, toms, brushes (ballad, waltz and swing), a waltz, a gospel shuffle, a 6/8 ballad, 6/8 Celtic toms, a train beat, kick and clap, a cajon groove, shaker and congas, a frame drum in 6/8 and a cinematic swell. 10.5: a Lo-fi Kit, a Vintage Kit, a Quiet Upright Bass and a Banjo (all CC0), and twelve more loops, every groove at three tempos - a worship pocket, a tom groove, a four-bar builder, gospel 12/8, a country two-step, soft pop, two lo-fi beats, a processional march, tambourine and shaker, a djembe groove and timpani under a hymn.

libraries.title: Central Pedals Library

libraries.title: Central Pads Library
libraries.summary: 41 pads for the pad pedal in all 12 keys, each built its own way (its own voices, movement, stereo and reverb) and each a seamless 12-second stereo loop of the key's chord, played as recorded (no pitch shifting): warm, air, choir aah, ooh and hum, shimmer, strings, bowed, glass, bells, felt, organ, analog, swell, worship, ambient drone, cinematic, deep, heaven and morning; Sunday Keys (the modern worship pad); nine made from real recordings (Ember, Halo, Selah, Dawn, Frozen Piano, Bowed Glass, Vibes, Harp Wash, Cathedral Organ); and tide, vowels, tape, sparkle, eighties, reed, swell guitar, breathe, tanpura, horns and flute choir. Plus Central Pads Swells - swells, risers, downlifters and an arrival in every key at 4, 8 and 16 seconds, and an air bed for between songs - and eight ambient loops for the texture channels in every key (Sparkle, Drift, Breath, Felt Piano, Guitar Swells, Cello Drone, Choir Air and Harp Rain). Comes with every other plan too. 35 more pads, moving pads and more swells come in Central Pads Extra, a second download with the same key. 10.5: seven more ambient loops in every key - Piano Arps, Organ Swell, Strings Rise, Bell Tower, Guitar Arpeggio, Wurlitzer Haze and Hum Drone Every pad now at one loudness (10.5).

libraries.title: Central Pads Extra
libraries.summary: 35 more pads for the pad pedal in all 12 keys, each built its own way: Sunday Keys in five more colours (warm, bright, dark, air, cinematic), Ambient Guitar and Synth Swell; Christmas Bells, Music Box, Easter Brass, Advent Glass and Candlelight; pads made from real recordings - oboe, clarinet, bassoon, flute, trumpet, trombone, violas, contrabasses, marimba, kalimba, mbira, ocarina, recorders, harmonica, sax, zither, a Renaissance organ and wine glasses; and Granular Choir, Pluck Cloud, Phaser Pad, Lo-fi Keys and Wide Fifths. Plus six moving pads for the texture channels that pulse in time with the song (eighths, sixteenths, heartbeat, trance gate, pump, bar swell) and Central Pads Swells Extra - choir, brass and breath swells, shimmer rises, an outro wash and a tape stop in every key, noise uplifters and a sub drop. A second download with the same Pads key: comes with every plan. 1.1 (10.5): every pad at the same loudness as the others.

libraries.title: Central Pads More
libraries.summary: 24 more pads for the pad pedal in all 12 keys (10.5), each a 24-second seamless loop so its movement takes longer to come round: Sunday Shimmer, Deep Worship, Analog Strings (a 70s string machine), Glass Choir, Prayer Room, Cathedral Choir, Rising Tide, Organ Pad, Choir and Strings, Still Waters, Chapel Harmonium, Pentecost Fire, Night Sky, Communion, Tape Strings, Kingdom Come (the big one for the last chorus), Advent Waiting, Gospel Organ (the Leslie on fast), Rain on the Roof, and five made from real recordings - Celtic Air (flutes and a harp), Glacier (violins frozen in a shimmer), Soft Brass (horns and trombones), Harvest (marimba and strings) and Heartstrings (cellos and violas breathing). Plus six more moving pads for the texture channels (dotted eighths, sixteenth shimmer, a slow breath, push and pull, a quarter swell and a half-time pulse). A third download with the same Pads key: comes with every plan.

libraries.title: Central Utility Library
libraries.summary: Fourteen metronome click sets (wood block, rim, hi-hat, cowbell, clave, shaker, side stick, triangle, mechanical tick, beeps, square blip, low tom, finger snap), each with its own accent, for a song's Click sound; and 24 lighting looks for the lights page (sunrise, ocean, candlelight, backlit cross, royal purple, gospel celebration, hymn rock, communion, baptism, Christmas, Easter, sermon, kids, youth and more). Built into the apps and unlocked by this plan: 118 lyric backgrounds for the church year (Advent, Christmas, Epiphany, Lent, Palm Sunday, Good Friday, Easter, Pentecost, communion, baptism, Mother's and Father's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year), for every Sunday (worship lights, nature, stained glass, calm textures for scripture) and in youth and kids styles, with a This Sunday suggestion from the church calendar; 51 slide themes with lower thirds in the same colours; and 52 slide layouts and graphics for the slide designer - announcements with a sign-up QR, sermon series and points, fill-in-the-blank, scripture, giving with a QR, welcome loops, baptism, communion, prayer and kids' ministry, plus countdowns, lower thirds and stream overlays. All made by Motion Audio.
